name: Document - Document Stats Dashboard
description: Thống kê tài liệu: số lượng, trạng thái, thời gian xử lý

native.query: SELECT status, COUNT(*) as count FROM doc_documents WHERE tenant_id = {{tenant_id}} AND deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY status ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT doc_type, COUNT(*) as count FROM doc_documents WHERE tenant_id = {{tenant_id}} AND deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY doc_type
SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM doc_documents WHERE tenant_id = {{tenant_id}} AND created_at >= date_trunc('week', NOW()) AND deleted_at IS NULL

cards.name: Văn bản đang xử lý (Top người phụ trách)

native.query: SELECT assigned_to, COUNT(*) as count FROM doc_documents WHERE tenant_id = {{tenant_id}} AND status IN ('RECEIVED','PENDING_APPROVAL','IN_PROGRESS') AND deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY assigned_to ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 10
